build_cpc_feature_reader: build a python module that loads a CPC checkpoint and extracts features from audio waveforms
run_cpc_get_features: run the CpcFeatureReader get_features method to extract CPC features from a torch tensor audio signal
create_cpc_encoder: create a CPCEncoder conv1d stack that downsamples raw audio by a factor of 160
test_cpc_model_extract: test the CPCModel extract_features method to get encoded or normalized CPC features from audio input
review_channel_norm: review the ChannelNorm class that applies per-channel normalization with optional affine parameters
